# FerrumOS

> FerrumOS is a bootable Rust x86-64 research operating system where an AI agent runs in Ring 3 and every effect remains subject to kernel-enforced authority.

- [Website](https://ferrum-os.vercel.app/)

## Claim boundary

FerrumOS v0.1.1 is a research OS and QEMU appliance, not a production-ready general-purpose OS or certified safety platform. Physical results are simulator-only. Neural results use deterministic synthetic or recorded evidence; there is no live-EEG accuracy or medical claim.

Current main contains newer research work than v0.1.1. Machine-readable snapshots identify their source commit and content hash; do not describe main-branch evidence as shipped in v0.1.1.
